create_tokenizer: create a Sentencepiece-based tokenizer that tokenizes and pads input text to a fixed max length
build_embedding_layer: build a Flax embedding layer that performs embedding lookups with optional sqrt-depth scaling
generate_positional_embedding: generate fixed sinusoidal positional embeddings for a 1-D sequence given a sequence length
apply_global_average_pooling: apply global average pooling over input tensors while respecting padding masks
build_stacked_transformer: build a stacked transformer encoder with configurable layers, attention heads, and stochastic depth
